easter-26.quote: Because there are many at this time who say that they fear and love God, but in their works show the contrary; but God requireth that love which is shown by works.
easter-26.who: St. John Chrysostom, Homilies on John
easter-26.question: Where does your love for Christ currently live only in words? Choose one concrete act of obedience to do today.

easter-27.quote: That we should establish ourselves in a sense of God’s Presence, by continually conversing with Him.
easter-27.who: Brother Lawrence, The Practice of the Presence of God
easter-27.question: Christ promises not to leave you orphaned. At what moment today could you simply turn and speak to him?

easter-28.quote: Peace He leaveth with us, that here also we may love one another: His own peace will He give us, where we shall be beyond the possibility of dissension.
easter-28.question: Whose quarrel is keeping your peace from being shared? Name one person you will make a first move toward today.

easter-29.quote: For although, when the branch beareth little fruit, the husbandman purgeth it that it may bring forth more; yet if it abide not in the vine, and draw its life from the root, it can bear no fruit whatever of itself.
easter-29.question: Where are you trying to bear fruit on your own strength? Set aside ten quiet minutes today to draw from the root.

easter-30.quote: It is not, then, for the purpose of awakening His love to us that we first keep His commandments; but this, that unless He loves us, we cannot keep His commandments.
easter-30.question: If his love comes first, what burden of earning it can you lay down today, and obey from gratitude instead?

easter-31.quote: Ye see, beloved, how great and wonderful a thing is love, and that there is no declaring its perfection.
easter-31.who: St. Clement of Rome, First Letter to the Corinthians
easter-31.question: Who in your life needs to be loved as Christ has loved you? Decide one costly way to show it this week.

easter-32.quote: We are therefore to understand that he who loves has already the Holy Spirit, and by what he has becomes worthy of a fuller possession, that by having the more he may love the more.
easter-32.question: Where do you already sense the Spirit's presence in your love? Ask today for a fuller measure, and name what you will do with it.

easter-33.quote: The Spirit is a gift of God, but a gift of life, for the law of “the Spirit of life,” it is said, “hath made” us “free;”
easter-33.who: St. Basil the Great, On the Holy Spirit
easter-33.question: What in you still feels bound or lifeless? Ask the Spirit to teach and free you there, and listen for his answer.

easter-34.quote: For not even to His elect in this life has He promised the joys of delight, but the bitternesses of tribulation; so that, after the manner of medicine, they may be restored through a bitter cup to the sweetness of eternal salvation.
easter-34.question: What current trouble could you carry today as something Christ has already overcome? Bring it to him in prayer by name.

easter-35.quote: It is the same thing, therefore, that He now also prayed for in our behalf, as He did at that time in theirs, namely, that all—to wit, both we and they—may be one.
easter-35.question: Jesus prayed for your unity before you were born. Which division in your family, parish or workplace will you pray over today?

easter-36.quote: It is profitable, therefore, that you should live in an unblameable unity, that thus ye may always enjoy communion with God.
easter-36.who: St. Ignatius of Antioch, Letter to the Ephesians
easter-36.question: What small habit of criticism or grumbling weakens the unity Christ prayed for? Replace it today with one word of encouragement.

easter-37.quote: I could not be then, O my God, could not be at all, wert Thou not in me; or, rather, unless I were in Thee, of whom are all things, by whom are all things, in whom are all things?
easter-37.question: Christ in you and the Father in him: how does that change one thing you will say or do today?

easter-38.quote: Thou awakest us to delight in Thy praise; for Thou madest us for Thyself, and our heart is restless, until it repose in Thee.
easter-38.question: Christ longs for you to be where he is. What restless pursuit might you set down today to rest in him?

easter-39.quote: And so, dearly-beloved, let us rejoice with spiritual joy, and let us with gladness pay God worthy thanks and raise our hearts’ eyes unimpeded to those heights where Christ is.
easter-39.who: St. Leo the Great, Sermon on the Lord's Ascension
easter-39.question: Tomorrow we remember the Lord's ascension. What one earthly worry can you consciously lift up to Christ this evening?

easter-40.quote: Since then Christ’s Ascension is our uplifting, and the hope of the Body is raised, whither the glory of the Head has gone before, let us exult, dearly-beloved, with worthy joy and delight in the loyal paying of thanks.
easter-40.who: St. Leo the Great, Sermon on the Lord's Ascension
easter-40.question: Where Christ the Head has gone, his Body follows. How will you let that hope shape one decision today?

easter-41.quote: We have learnt from the Apostle, “the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God and into the patient waiting for Christ”
easter-41.who: St. Basil the Great, On the Holy Spirit
easter-41.question: Waiting with Christ's promise is an act of love, not idleness. Where are you being asked to wait, and how will you wait well?

easter-42.quote: For the Spirit made them men of iron instead of men of clay, gave them wings, and allowed them to be cast down by nothing human.
easter-42.who: St. John Chrysostom, Homilies on John
easter-42.question: Where do you feel like clay, afraid to witness to Christ? Ask for the Spirit's strength before you speak or act today.

easter-43.quote: Hence it is with justice and truth that we call the holy Mary the Mother of God. For this name embraces the whole mystery of the dispensation.
easter-43.who: St. John of Damascus, On the Orthodox Faith
easter-43.question: Mary waits with the disciples as Mother of the Lord. Ask for her prayers today for someone you are waiting alongside.

easter-44.quote: being come together into the same place, let there be one prayer, one supplication, one mind, one hope, in love and in joy undefiled.
easter-44.who: St. Ignatius of Antioch, Letter to the Magnesians
easter-44.question: Who could you pray with today, even briefly, in person or by phone, as the disciples prayed together in the upper room?

easter-45.quote: For it is the strength of great minds and the light of firmly-faithful souls, unhesitatingly to believe what is not seen with the bodily sight, and there to fix one’s affections whither you cannot direct your gaze.
easter-45.who: St. Leo the Great, Sermon on the Lord's Ascension
easter-45.question: What are you waiting for that you cannot yet see? Take one step today that trusts the promise rather than the outcome.

easter-46.quote: For my part I keep myself retired with Him in the depth of centre of my soul as much as I can; and while I am so with Him I fear nothing; but the least turning from Him is insupportable.
easter-46.who: Brother Lawrence, The Practice of the Presence of God
easter-46.question: When can you give God five wordless minutes today, with your phone silent? Choose the time now and keep it.

easter-47.quote: And when Thou art poured out on us, Thou art not cast down, but Thou upliftest us; Thou art not dissipated, but Thou gatherest us.
easter-47.question: God promises to pour out his Spirit. What would you ask him to gather and lift in you, or in your household?

easter-48.quote: He came to thee in the flesh, that He might bedew thy thirsty lips: He will satisfy thee trusting, who bedewed thee thirsting.
easter-48.who: St. Augustine, Expositions on the Psalms
easter-48.question: What are you thirsting for that you keep seeking elsewhere? Bring that thirst to Christ in prayer today.

easter-49.quote: Mistress of all good things is charity, which savours of nothing extraneous, nothing rough, nothing confused; which so exercises and strengthens hearts that nothing is heavy, nothing difficult, but all that is done becomes sweet.
easter-49.question: On the eve of Pentecost, which heavy task could love make lighter? Ask the Spirit to pour that love into your heart tonight.

easter-50.quote: For the Spirit of Truth Himself makes the house of His glory shine with the brightness of His light, and will have nothing dark nor lukewarm in His temple.
easter-50.who: St. Leo the Great, Sermon on Whitsuntide
easter-50.question: What dark or lukewarm corner of your life will you open to the Spirit today, so that his fire can reach it?
